preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 10**4
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression:
all(line.strip() == '' for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() == '' and line != stdin.split('
')[0])
preconditions.description: Each test case is preceded by an empty line, except the first line.

preconditions.expression:
all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '))
preconditions.description: Each edge description line contains exactly two integers a_i and b_i (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' ') for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Vertices are numbered from 1 to n, and edges are valid (1 ≤ a_i, b_i ≤ n).

preconditions.expression:
all(len(set((int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' '))) == len([line for line in stdin.split('
') if line.strip() and not line.startswith(' ')]))
preconditions.description: The graph has no multi-edges (no duplicate edges).

postconditions.expression:
all(len(output_line.split()) == n for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line contains exactly n integers, one for each vertex.

postconditions.expression:
all(int(x) in {0, 1, 2, -1} for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip() for x in output_line.split())
postconditions.description: Each output value for a vertex is one of {0, 1, 2, -1}.

postconditions.expression:
all(0 <= int(x) <= 2 or int(x) == -1 for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip() for x in output_line.split())

all(len(stdout.split('
')) == t + 1 and all(line.strip() == '' or all(c in '012-1' for c in line) for line in stdout.split('
')))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines (one per test case), each line is either empty or contains valid output values.

postconditions.expression:
all(len(output_line.split()) == n for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line has exactly n values, corresponding to vertices 1 to n.

postconditions.expression:
all(1 <= int(v) <= n for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip() for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The output values correspond to vertices 1 to n in order.

postconditions.expression:
all((int(output_line.split()[v-1]) == 0 and not any(path_exists(1, v, graph))) or (int(output_line.split()[v-1]) == 1 and exactly_one_path(1, v, graph)) or (int(output_line.split()[v-1]) == 2 and more_than_one_path(1, v, graph) and not infinite_paths(1, v, graph)) or (int(output_line.split()[v-1]) == -1 and infinite_paths(1, v, graph)) for output_line in stdout.split('
') if output_line.strip() for v in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v, the output value is 0 if no paths exist from 1 to v, 1 if exactly one path exists, 2 if more than one finite path exists, and -1 if infinite paths exist.
